items.quote: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre
items.claim: Isaac and Ishmael buried Abraham in the cave of Machpelah in the field of Ephron before Mamre
items.place: cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre

items.quote: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth
items.claim: Abraham purchased the field from the sons of Heth

items.quote: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife
items.claim: Abraham and Sarah were buried in the field Abraham had purchased
